description_zh: 调用该接口创建声码排程
name: CreateSoundCodeSchedule

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The schedule name. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The name must be unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 排程名称，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The schedule description. The description must be 1 to 64 characters in length. A Chinese character counts as two characters. The description must be unique within the instance
parameters.help_zh: 排程描述，长度为1~64个字符，一个汉字占两个字符，实例下保证唯一
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The start date of the schedule. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 排程开始工作日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of the schedule. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. The end date cannot be earlier than the start date specified by StartDate
parameters.help_zh: 排程结束工作日期，格式为yyyy-MM-dd，不得早于StartDate
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The open type of the schedule.

Internal (default): Set the value to INNER. Only devices within the instance where the schedule resides can request sound code decoding.

Public: Set the value to OPEN. You can configure a whitelist by sending emails to allow devices from other instances to request sound code decoding. The usage of cross-instance decoding is calculated under the instance where the sound code resides
parameters.help_zh:
排程开放类型。

内部（默认）：取值为INNER，只允许排程所在实例下的设备请求声码解码。

公开：取值为OPEN，可以发送邮件的方式配置白名单，允许跨实例的设备请求声码解码，跨实例解码的用量计算在声码所在的实例下
parameters.name: open_type

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The unique identifier of the schedule

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: sound code service has not been signed

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
